reason: I already have a drawer of half-used supplement bottles, and I know I'd stop taking sachets after a week. The lab report and the guarantee are nice, but they don't fix that I don't stick with these things.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other products put several forms in one capsule? And I'd be paying $30 a month for something I'll probably quit and leave in the drawer.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing someone with my exact sleep problem actually sleeping better on it after a couple of weeks, plus a plain explanation of why bisglycinate alone is enough.
